summary: Redwood Trust Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of $125 million aggregate principal amount of 9.75% Senior Notes due 2031, issued at $25 per unit. The notes mature June 1, 2031, pay quarterly interest, and are redeemable at par after June 1, 2028. Proceeds to the issuer are $121.1 million before expenses. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley and RBC. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation, as it involves an ordinary shelf takedown of unsecured notes for general corporate purposes.
